questions.question: Clarify al-Khwarizmi’s approximate life dates, his connection with the Bayt al-Hikma, and the survival of his work on Indian arithmetic.

localizations.source: Clarify al-Khwarizmi’s approximate life dates, his connection with the Bayt al-Hikma, and the survival of his work on Indian arithmetic.
localizations.ru: Уточнить приблизительные даты жизни, связь аль-Хорезми с Байт аль-хикма и сохранность труда об индийском счёте.

questions.resolution: The dates were corrected to c. 780–c. 850; the text now describes an association with the caliphal library Bayt al-Hikma and records that the Arabic original is lost and the work survives in a substantially reworked twelfth-century Latin version. Evidence: https://ismi.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/biography/Khwarizmi_BEA.htm, https://ismi.mpiwg-berlin.mpg.de/text/336395, https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/HistTopics/Arabic_numerals/
